entities.name: UniProt P22669
observations: Reviewed Aspergillus aculeatus endoglucanase-1; exact full-length sequence match to query; annotated EC 3.2.1.4 and secreted localization.
EC 3.2.1.4 reaction annotation: endohydrolysis of (1→4)-β-D-glucosidic linkages in cellulose, lichenin, and cereal β-D-glucans.

entities.name: Endo-β-1,4-glucan hydrolysis
observations: Hydrolyzes internal (1→4)-β-D-glucosidic bonds in cellulose and related β-glucans, yielding shorter oligosaccharides and new chain ends.
